_about: The WhatsApp bot's QA deck for scripts/wa_qa.py. Every resident is invented; the only building used for anything that writes is בר כוכבא 23 (the one opened for testing), and nothing here writes anywhere. `expect` is checked by the grader and never shown to the players; `judge` lines go to the blind judges. iso is the scenario's clock in UTC (Israel is UTC+3 in October). A bug found on a handset is a scenario added here.

scenarios.title: the gate lock, Hebrew, first contact

resident.persona: דני, גר בבר כוכבא 23 דירה 4; הבניין יש לו שני שערים, הכניסה והחניה; הבעיה בשער החניה מאחור

script.if_asked: which gate / where exactly / what exactly is wrong

expect.regex: איזה שער|איפה (בדיוק )?השער|באיזה שער|איזה מה?שערים|מה בדיוק|איפה בדיוק|איזה מנעול
expect.name: asks which gate or where before opening
no guessed gate in the replies

judge: asks_which_gate: before opening, did Michael ask which gate or where exactly (not the building) at least once?
ticket_in_their_words: does the ticket description hold only what the resident wrote (no 'entrance', no cause)?
one_question_per_message: does every message carry at most one question (building+apartment count as one)?
human_word_first: before the first question, is there a short human reaction to the broken lock, not a summary and not 'I understand'?
no_promise: after the ticket, nothing about soon, when, who, or 'I'm handling it'?
goodbye: does the reply to 'תודה' close warmly with no question?
